description.value: Fortuna Bakery & Deli is a family-owned Portuguese and Italian bakery and deli that has operated on Hastings Street in Burnaby for over 40 years. All breads, pastries, and baked goods are crafted fresh daily using what the business describes as only the freshest ingredients, with custom orders available for cakes and deli platters. Beyond the bakery itself, the shop offers made-to-order sandwiches, meat and cheese platters, a full-service barista bar, and a selection of groceries — making it a useful resupply stop for cyclists passing through East Burnaby.
